The dish is a bowl about 15 cm across, holding pineapple chunks, strawberries and blueberries.

I count about 7 large pineapple chunks, roughly 100 g in total. I see about 4–5 strawberry pieces, roughly 60 g, and about 8 blueberries, roughly 15 g. That comes to about 175 g of fruit.

Pineapple is about 50 kcal per 100 g, so 100 g gives roughly 50 kcal. Strawberries at about 32 kcal per 100 g give roughly 20 kcal for 60 g. Blueberries at about 57 kcal per 100 g give roughly 9 kcal for 15 g. The total is about 80 kcal. Allowing for a slightly larger portion, I'll round up to about 190 g and 90 kcal.
